author: Tikai
body:
Hi,

I was banned 3-4 months ago for Refusal to Screenshare.
I understand that my ignorance on the subject led to my ban and i'm sorry.
My IGN is "xLykos" but my IGN at the time was " iTimeless ".
I made a 1st appeal but didn't know if I should appeal sooner or later.
I really want to be unbanned as i've made friends in the Avicus community and would like to continue being part of it.

Thanks for your consideration,
iTimeless/xLykos

title: Appeal

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
Sorry for the late response.

You will be unbanned, not now however. You were banned about 3 months ago, and people should wait 5-8 months for their ban to be appealed. Thus, I suggest waiting another 1.5 to 3 months for making another appeal, which will most likely be accepted.

This is denied for now, but I'll leave it unlocked for 24 hours in case you have any questions. If so, quote me please.

Regards,
Tazz // Avicus Moderator/ Official

replies.body: It depends if/when the way tournament bans are are changed. you will be able to. But currently, if you were unbanned, you would not be able to because it prevents you from being in a team if you are tournament banned.
